method: Bounded public-web search of Russian federal official surfaces and indexed public previews. No authentication, platform API, access-control bypass, inferred sequential post identifiers, bulk capture, binary download, or precise operational-location retention was used.

sources_checked.target: Ministry of Defence of the Russian Federation Telegram channel
sources_checked.result: The public channel and indexed previews were searched for the assigned interval. Search results exposed older publications, including records from 2022–2024 and the already collected pre-05:00 UTC identifiers 66272 and 66273, but did not expose a stable in-window post page with a verifiable publication timestamp. Sequential identifiers were not guessed or registered.

sources_checked.target: Ministry of Defence of the Russian Federation MAX channel
sources_checked.result: The official MAX surface and indexed results were searched by exact date and daily-summary phrasing. Stable July 2026 publications were indexed, confirming the official surface, but no 5 August 2026 publication was returned during the bounded pass.

sources_checked.target: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation Telegram channel
sources_checked.result: Exact-date and Ukraine-related searches did not return a stable, clearly in-window official frontline or strike statement.

sources_checked.target: Kremlin public Telegram and official website surfaces
sources_checked.result: Exact-date searches did not return a stable, clearly in-window Kremlin frontline or strike publication.
Bounded exact-date searches across mil.ru, mid.ru, and kremlin.ru did not surface a stable official page matching the task topics and interval.

excluded_candidates.source: Ministry of Defence Telegram messages 66272 and 66273
excluded_candidates.reason: Already represented by canonical URLs and collected for the prior 00:00–05:00 UTC interval; excluded as explicit duplicates and out-of-window records.

excluded_candidates.source: Historical Ministry of Defence search results for 5 August in 2022, 2023, and 2024
excluded_candidates.reason: The calendar day matched but the publication years were outside the assigned 2026 interval.

excluded_candidates.source: Unresolved current-channel entries adjacent to previously known identifiers
excluded_candidates.reason: No stable public result established both canonical identifier and publication time; inferred sequential identifiers are not admissible evidence.

access_failures.target: Current Ministry of Defence Telegram interval
access_failures.detail: Public search indexing did not expose exact in-window post pages. The channel preview could not be deterministically positioned at the target interval through approved public-web discovery.

access_failures.target: Current Ministry of Defence MAX interval
access_failures.detail: The official channel was discoverable and older July 2026 posts were indexed, but exact-date searches returned no stable 5 August record during the pass.
Exact-date searches did not resolve a stable mil.ru, mid.ru, or kremlin.ru page corresponding to a qualifying in-window statement.

artifact_capture.reason: No qualifying canonical source item was resolved, and no immutable permitted artifact was available for capture.

coverage_gaps: The result is a bounded zero-item discovery outcome, not evidence that Russian official institutions published nothing during the interval.
Telegram public previews and search indexes may omit, delay, edit, or delete posts and do not provide API-grade completeness or complete edit history.
MAX search indexing exposed older official posts but no exact-date result, so cross-platform completeness could not be established.
No sequential Telegram identifier was guessed, and no item lacking both a stable canonical URL and verifiable in-window timestamp was registered.
No attached media was downloaded, hashed, or independently verified.
No Russian official assertion was independently assessed or converted into a claim, observation, territorial conclusion, or report narrative.
safety_notes: No precise current positions, movement routes, active-unit locations, target coordinates, or vulnerable-facility details were persisted.
No non-public material, authenticated platform data, or access-control bypass was used.
A zero-result receipt was preferred over registering uncertain identifiers or timestamps.
